# TestEverySourceFileExistsInCCPsExport checks every tableSpec.source
# against this list. It exists because the importer spent its whole
# life asking for <postgres table name>.jsonl — category.jsonl,
# group_.jsonl, type.jsonl — none of which appears below, and every
# test passed because the fixtures had been named to match the code
# rather than recorded from the export.
